instruction: Write one text prompt for a text-to-music model. The prompt asks for an instrumental backing track recorded and produced in {dec}. Describe the instruments, rhythm, and the recording, mixing and mastering style typical of {dec}, in a single sentence of at most 30 words. Do not mention artists, song titles, lyrics or vocals. Output only the prompt.

1960s: Create an instrumental track with a vintage 1960s sound, featuring electric guitar, bass, drums, and organ, with a lively rhythm, warm analog recording, and authentic tape compression effects.

Create an instrumental track with a blend of acoustic guitar, bass, and drums, featuring a folk-rock rhythm, recorded with analog tape, mixed with stereo separation, and mastered with warmth and depth typical of 1960s production.
Create an instrumental backing track with a blend of electric guitars, bass, drums, and organ, featuring a swinging rhythm and warm, analog tape sound typical of 1960s recording studios.
Create an instrumental backing track with a mix of electric guitar, bass, drums, and Hammond organ, featuring a swinging rhythm and a warm analog sound typical of 1960s recording techniques.
Create an instrumental backing track with a Fender Rhodes piano, bass guitar, and brushes on a snare drum, recorded with tape hiss and saturated warmth typical of 1960s analog recording.

Create an instrumental track with a blend of clean guitars, rhythmic bass, and drums, featuring organ and strings, recorded with vintage microphones, showcasing 1960s analog tape compression and warmth.
Create an instrumental backing track with a rhythmic blend of electric guitar, bass, and drums, featuring a sitar and organ, recorded with vintage analog equipment in a lively, resonant studio.
Create an instrumental backing track with a rhythm guitar, bass, drums, and Hammond organ, recorded in a warm, analog style with tape hiss and natural reverb.
1980s: Create an instrumental backing track with synthesizers, electric pianos, and drum machines, featuring a syncopated rhythm and 1980s recording techniques with prominent reverb and analog effects.

Create an instrumental backing track with synthesizers, electric guitars, and drum machines, featuring a catchy beat and layered sounds, characteristic of 1980s recording, mixing, and mastering techniques.
Create an 1980s instrumental track with synths, electric piano, and drum machines, featuring a steady beat and prominent bass, recorded with analog equipment and warm, rich reverb.
Create an instrumental track with synthesizers, electric guitars, and drum machines, featuring a disco-influenced rhythm, recorded with analog equipment and mastered with prominent bass and treble.
Create an instrumental track with synthesizers, electric guitars, and drum machines, featuring a pulsating rhythm and 1980s analog recording quality with prominent reverb and echo effects.

Create an instrumental backing track with synthesizers, electric pianos, and drum machines, featuring a rhythmic 808 kick, snare, and hi-hats, recorded with tape saturation and mastered with analog warmth.

Create an instrumental track from the 1980s with synthesizers, electric guitars, and drums, featuring a prominent bassline and rhythmic patterns, recorded with analog equipment, and mixed/mastered with reverb and tape saturation.
Create an 1980s instrumental track with electric guitars, synthesizers, drum machines, and bass, featuring gated reverb drums and prominent analog synth pads, recorded with plenty of tape hiss.
2010s: Create an instrumental backing track with a blend of electronic drums, synth leads, and warm analog bass, typical of 2010s production, with a polished yet slightly lo-fi edge in mixing and mastering.

Create an instrumental backing track with a blend of electronic and acoustic elements, featuring electric guitar, drums, synthesizers, and bass, with a steady beat and subtle reverb, characteristic of 2010s production.
Create an instrumental track with a blend of electronic synths, warm analog bass, and crisp drums, typical of 2010s production, with polished yet subtle reverb and EQ.

Create an instrumental track with a blend of electronic synths, distorted electric guitars, and heavy percussion, characteristic of 2010s recording, mixing with clear separation and mastering that emphasizes bass and treble.
Create an instrumental track with a blend of electronic synths, live drums, and bass, featuring a rhythmic 808 kick, snappy snares, and warm analog tones, typical of 2010s production.

Create an instrumental backing track with a blend of electronic synths, electric guitars, and live drums, featuring a steady hip-hop beat with subtle bass drops, recorded with a warm, slightly compressed mix and mastered for loudness.

Create an instrumental track from the 2010s with electronic drums, synth bass, and guitar, featuring a steady beat and atmospheric synths, recorded with a modern clarity and warmth, mastered for loudness and punch.
Create an instrumental track with a blend of electronic and acoustic elements, featuring drums, bass, synthesizers, and guitar, recorded with a polished, modern sound typical of 2010s production.
